items.title: GentleKiller Ransomware Abuses Vulnerable Drivers to Disable 400+ EDR Security Processes
items.description: A highly sophisticated EDR-killing framework, dubbed GentleKiller, was used by the Gentlemen ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) gang to systematically disable endpoint security tools before deploying its ransomware payload.
